remote.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = json.dumps({
  "host_address": "192.168.10.1",
  "dhcp_mode": "dhcp",
  "dhcp_range_start": "192.168.10.100",
  "dhcp_range_stop": "192.168.10.200",
  "dhcp_lease_time": 86400
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("PUT", "/v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices/{deviceID}/network", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
